# Cylvox

> A solo engineering studio specializing in high-concurrency workflow automation, Next.js performance, and technical SEO.

## About Cylvox
Cylvox is run by Supun Sanjana, a Lead Web Engineer & Technical SEO Specialist. We harden AI-assisted apps before they scale, migrate slow legacy sites to modern stacks, and build automation that runs without supervision. Proof, not promises.

## Key Services
- **Technical SEO & Core Web Vitals:** We engineer sites to hit 99/100 PageSpeed scores, implement dynamic JSON-LD structured data, and architect Next.js server components for maximum crawl efficiency.
- **Workflow Automation:** We build scalable backend pipelines using self-hosted n8n, replacing expensive traditional iPaaS (like Zapier) with robust, version-controlled automation.
- **Modern Web Architecture:** Migrating and building custom solutions using Next.js 15, React, TypeScript, and modern headless infrastructure.
